task_text: Explore a stone building. Find the stone stairs at the entrance and climb in. Navigate the cracked stone brick hallway, then explore two branches: the left corridor has a gray room (concrete powder walls, carpet floor) leading to a bedroom with a purple bed and a redstone block in the back wall. The right corridor has a pink room with glass pane windows and a pink concrete wall sealing a back storage room containing green concrete. Mine the redstone block, mine through the pink concrete wall, and collect green concrete from the sealed storage.
